closest_prior_work.work: Task14 whole-head P and cross-circuit controls
closest_prior_work.relation: They test a complete native head boundary, not the newly localized subject-source projected value. The ordinary P rows also keep the subject token fixed, so they cannot test whether subject payload generalizes across noun identity.

It identifies a subject-payload signal on answer-changing SELECT rows, but its donors jointly change subject number, noun identity, and syntax. It explicitly makes no selectivity or stable-identification claim.

novelty: First causally matched specificity test for the Task14 L11H3 subject-source projected value. For every recipient, both donors change subject noun and syntax; the same-state donor preserves grammatical number while the positive-control donor reverses it. The same exact payload-only intervention must stay small for the same-state donor and transfer the is/are answer for the opposite-state donor.
known_lessons_applied: The control is paired with a live opposite-number positive control using the same intervention, so a dead or weak knob cannot make invariance pass.
Task margins and donor-answer CE are primary; activation reconstruction and rank are excluded.
This remains SELECT-only. TEST and OOD are closed until the below-head variable survives specificity.
